# Button

Pill buttons; primary is ink, needs is reserved for resolving a waiting decision.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.Button`

## Notes

Pill button (web/src ui.tsx). primary = ink pill · secondary = surface-2 pill · ghost = Bencho hover wash that springs in from the center · needs = vermilion, reserved for the action that resolves a waiting decision. All variants press to scale(.96) with the settle spring. Heights 28 / 34 / 44. @startingPoint section="Core" subtitle="Pill buttons: primary, secondary, ghost, needs" viewport="700x220"
